turns.text: Yesterday, I was implementing the new UI components for the dashboard and ran into some issues with state management in React.
turns.zh: 昨天我在给仪表盘做新的 UI 组件，结果在 React 的状态管理上碰到了一些问题。

turns.text: Today, I'll be refactoring the code to use Redux for better state handling.
turns.zh: 今天我会重构代码，改用 Redux 来更好地处理状态。
又是状态管理的问题啊。
